info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Weather Alerts Currents-v5-spec
info.description: The Current Weather Alerts API provides real-time notifications of active weather alerts, enabling businesses to stay informed about severe weather conditions. Users can retrieve detailed information about current alerts, including types of alerts, affected areas, and severity levels. This API is particularly valuable for organizations such as emergency services, transportation authorities, and event planners that need timely weather updates for decision-making and safety measures. By integrating this API, developers can enhance their applications with critical weather data to ensure user safety and operational continuity.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current alerts from the system. Alerts may include notifications about various events or statuses that require user attention.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the current alerts. This should include any necessary filters or parameters to customize the retrieval of alerts.

ListWeatherAlertsCurrentsRequest.description: This schema represents the JSON request body for the GET operation of the current alerts.
